facts.fact: The IRM text says the national open data portal, run by the e-government unit of the Presidency of the Government, offered open datasets from 23 data producers across 6 themes as of April 2024.
The IRM text says 23 data producers published on the portal as of April 2024.
The IRM text reports 5 data reuses and 233 open data requests on the portal, and a 2023 Open Gov Data Hack run by the e-government unit with the health, social affairs and education ministries.
